outputs.title: Set up onboarding rules in BFFless for automatic repo access
outputs.summary: In this video I walk through configuring onboarding rules in BFFless so new users automatically get repository view access when they sign up. I create a rule called "user view access on create" in the site settings under authentication, set it to trigger on user sign up, and grant view-level access to a selected repository. I also enable public signups and then test the whole flow by creating a new account and browsing the backend at the admin URL to confirm the viewer permissions work as expected.
